parameters.query:
with alvo as (
  select o.id from public.outbound_contatos o
  where o.telefone = $1 and o.etapa = 'em_conversa'
  order by o.created_at desc
  limit 1
)
update public.outbound_contatos o
set etapa = 'interessado_transferido', updated_at = now()
from alvo
where o.id = alvo.id
returning o.id, o.campanha_id, o.id_externo, o.nome, o.mailing_id, o.telefone;

insert into public.sdr_eventos (mailing_id, telefone, tipo_evento, origem, nome_app, payload)
